_comment: Copy this file and edit it to match your CSV columns. Then pass it with --schema my_schema.json

_notes.distance_km: REQUIRED. Column containing road/route distance in kilometres.
_notes.travel_time_min: REQUIRED. Column containing travel time in minutes.
_notes.congestion_enc: OPTIONAL. If text, values must be: Low / Medium / High. If missing, defaults to Medium.
_notes.weather_enc: OPTIONAL. If text, values must be: Clear / Cloudy / Foggy / Rainy. If missing, defaults to Clear.
_notes.alternatives: OPTIONAL. Number of alternative routes. If missing, defaults to 2.
_notes.mode: Transport mode for this dataset: driving / matatu / danfo / boda / walking / rideshare
_notes.city: City name — used in dataset summary and future per-city model splits
